# Pins core/egress_detokenizer's `{user:<token>}` grammar to the Python oracle that
# sdk/waddle-sdk/tests/test_safe_text_differential.py uses to prove
# waddle_sdk.safe_text never lets an input through that the detokenizer would resolve.
# BOTH sides enumerate the same corpus -- every concatenation of `atoms` of length 0..=max_len
# (odometer order, last atom fastest), then each `case=` line -- run it through
# extract_tokens + detokenize(names: token -> `<N:token>`, Sink::Twitch), and hash the lines
# `hex(input)|hex(token),...|hex(output)\n` with FNV-1a 64. A grammar change on either side
# changes the digest: update the oracle, regenerate, and re-run the differential test.
